notes.title: New demo version of WARAG
notes.notes: [p]The time has come for a major update, timed to coincide with WARAG’s participation in the Boomstock 2025 festival. This is not just an update-it’s a complete conversion of the entire game![/p][p]For various reasons, I wasn’t able to implement everything I had planned, from fixing all the bugs to adding new animations. Nevertheless, this demo version will serve as a starting point for further improvements to the game. Instead of an early access release, I will be regularly updating and refining this very demo version.[/p][p]But even now, you can try it out and get a sense of the direction WARAG’s development is heading! Huge thanks for any feedback![/p]

notes.title: Demo v1.0 released!
